notes: Xiaomi-OCR-0_int8.litertlm of litert-community/Xiaomi-OCR-0: xiaomi-research/Xiaomi-OCR-0 (Apache-2.0, an OCR model trained from Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base: a 12-layer ViT and a Qwen3.5 hybrid text decoder) converted to LiteRT-LM as a fast_vlm bundle that reads one 768 x 1344 picture; the bundle carries a ChatML template with thinking off, stop tokens 248044 / 248046 and the repo's tokenizer.json byte for byte. Published 2026-11-03 (Hub main 2ba3d3c1 at the read). Measured 2026-11-02/03 in the run r3 (GPU runs of the published file; the CPU runs ran an unpublished copy).
quantization: dynamic INT8 decoder (per-channel INT8 weights on 151 fully connected layers, the 36 GatedDeltaNet decay/gate projections float, FP32 activations declared) and INT8 embedding table; vision encoder FP16 weights with FP16 activations declared (read by the GPU vision executor only), vision adapter INT8; KV cache 4,096; one 768 x 1344 picture (1,008 image tokens)

results.signature: the OCR gate: one picture + the card's prompt per fresh process (cache off), greedy, each reply judged by score_xocr.py against the original model's fp32 reading of the original picture
